startersHint: A starter sets the colours, the wording and the QR codes. You can change every line.
linkHint: Choose where the QR code goes above, and the help for that place shows here.
linkBad: This does not look like a web address yet. It should start with https:// or look like a website name.
linkOk: Link accepted. The QR code points to it.
linkSample: No link yet, so the QR code shows a sample address. Add your link before you print.
headline: Heading
ratingHint: Shows stars and your review count. Switch it off if you do not want them. Use only the real figures from your Google page, and update them when they change.
logo: Small logo next to the name (optional)
logoHint: Shown small, just left of your business name. Leave it out for a text-only sign.
logoFailed: That picture could not be read. Try a PNG or JPG.
sizeHint: The tent prints two strips on one A4. Cut along the marks, fold on the dashed line and stand it on the counter. The back half is printed upside down on purpose, so both faces read upright.
failed: The sign could not be made. Please try again.
check: Scan check on this device: the QR code reads back correctly.
checkFailed: Scan check: the QR code did not read back. Try a shorter link or a lighter colour.
checkUnavailable: Your browser cannot check the QR code itself. Scan the printout with your phone before you display it.
policy: For review links: Google asks businesses to invite reviews from all customers, and not to offer gifts or discounts for them. Other sites have their own rules, so check them.
notSaved: Your details stay on this device only. Nothing is uploaded.
showRating: Show a star rating and review count
ratingSample: These are sample figures (4.8 and 250). Replace them with your real rating and review count, or switch this option off, before you print.
what: 3. What should people scan to do?
whatHint: Choose where each QR code goes. One code makes a big, easy-to-scan sign. Add up to four to put review, follow and order links on one sign.
caption: Label under this QR code
captionHint: Shown only when the sign has two or more QR codes.
linkSampleMany: Some links are empty, so those codes show a sample address. Add your links before you print.
ratingHintFollow: For follow signs, type your follower count and leave the stars empty.
